summary: Crescent Private Credit Income Corp filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, reporting regular monthly distributions for its Class I, S, and D common shares, with net amounts of $0.16500, $0.14639, and $0.15953 per share respectively, payable on May 27, 2026 to holders of record April 30, 2026. It also disclosed net asset value per share as $26.27 for each class as of March 31, 2026, aggregate NAV of $503.5M, portfolio fair value of $877.1M, and debt of $464.5M (0.92x debt/equity). The continuous public offering of up to $2.5B in shares continues. No special-situation event occurred—this is a routine periodic disclosure of distributions and financials.
